why: Goal next-first-run-setup: the Set Up cmux card's provider, page host and first-run gate live in CmuxNextOnboarding (SetupCardPage.swift, FirstRunSetup.swift); the App keeps only adapters that need App-only types: HomeHostView showing the card (HomeHostView+SetupCard.swift), the account (services.cloud.auth) and the CLI rows (CLIInstallHandlers' PATH check and install) passed in as SetupCardEnvironment closures, and OnboardingService starting the card in place of the first-run windows. They go with the native Home when the React Home swap (#37736/#37777) lands.
